title: 📊 Daily Report: Tue Nov 10, 2026
text:
The swing book closed at $17,835.61. For the week it's up $16.69 against Monday's base: the strategies are up $16.69 and CORE QQQ is unchanged. Since the merge the book is down 10.91% ($2,185.13), while Indy (the SPY buy-and-hold benchmark) is down 3.68% ($736.54), so we're trailing by $1,448.59.

No bots traded today — the gate was open, but no setup met the entry rules. No positions were closed. Sunny is the only active bot; Trek and Rota have no edge, and the rest are benched. There are 5 open positions. CORE QQQ is off (in cash) with the trend filter out — prior close 679.35 vs the 200-day at 680.09. Idle cash earned $1.75 in interest today.

Research's analyst note for today:
- Hot October CPI (headline +0.4%, core +0.3% vs 0.2% est.) ended Monday's rally: the 10-yr went back above 5%, a December hike is all but priced, and Waller put 50bp on the table. The Dow closed -0.3%; the S&P fell about 0.4% and the Nasdaq about 0.7%.
- Nvidia was the main drag, closing -5.5% at $168.89 after its board hired outside counsel for the Huang probe. We extended the AI-hardware group avoid through Friday.
- Our avoids played out: HIMS fell about 18%, ONON about 8% and SKYD 9%. We logged no new longs into the CPI shock, per our rules.
- After the bell CoreWeave beat (revenue $3.66B vs $3.55B est.) and raised its full-year guide, a key test for the beaten-up AI-infrastructure group.
- Next up: Veterans Day Wednesday (stocks open, bonds closed), Nebius, Applied Materials and Cisco Thursday, jobless claims Thursday and PPI Friday.
